subject: PO pre-auth ledger ack + netterm carveout request
messages:
From: Katrina Lee <katrina.lee@horizontech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO fields, invoice cadence and pre-auth for Redwood contract

Hi Priyom / Vanessa,

We are ready to issue a purchase order for the Redwood pilot but AP has a few mandatory fields and cadence requirements before they can create the Po in our ERP:
- PO must include a single AP GL code (our ERP will not accept multiple GL combos)
- Vendor onboarding form completed (I attached our template)
- Net terms: default is net60; AP is pushing net45 for SaaS tools but we need confirmation
- Invoice cadence: AP prefers monthly consolidated invoices; they will not accept weekly tranches
- They want a 30–45 day pre-authorization window if we need an early invoice for ramping credits

We also need to confirm whether Redwood can accept a single blanket PO that covers multiple SOW line items (one PO, many invoices) or if you need individual POs per SOW.

Attaching HorizonTech PO template and vendor onboarding form for your review. If there is any required field mapping on your side (ERP id, tax entity, remit address) please let me know so AP can proceed.

Thanks,
Katrina Lee
Procurement Manager | HorizonTech
Attachments: Horizon_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx), VendorOnboardForm.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lee <katrina.lee@horizontech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO fields, invoice cadence and pre-auth for Redwood contract

Hi Katrina — thanks for the details and the templates. Quick answers upfront:
- We can accept a single blanket PO that covers multiple SOW line items; we will map invoice lines to the SOW codes you provide.
- We can produce consolidated monthly invoices against that blanket PO.
- Net terms: standard for this deal was net45 (on prior enterprise pilots) but we can be flexible given volume/commitments.
- Pre-auth: we can approve a one-time pre-authorization invoice up to $25k during ramp if Horizon provides an AP-approved PO header and a reference number.

Couple of asks from our finance team to make AP happy:
1) Please include HorizonTech ERP vendor id (if available) in the PO header or a PO comment field.
2) Add a single remit address and our Redwood vendor code: RW-00123.
3) If Horizon requires net60, we will need to align on a small adjustment to pricing; alternatively, if Horizon can commit to monthly invoicing and a quarterly spend commit threshold, we can offer a 2% net30-equivalent discount.

I attached a short Redwood PO instructions PDF that maps the fields your AP team typically needs to ours and a redlined SOW (SOW_Redwood_v2.pdf) showing line-level mapping examples.

Proposed next step: Vanessa / Finance and Katrina's AP rep on the same thread for final mapping and to confirm the discount lift. Can Vanessa advise on discount tolerance?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (pdf), SOW_Redwood_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Katrina Lee <katrina.lee@horizontech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: HorizonTech AP <ap@horizontech.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO fields, invoice cadence and pre-auth for Redwood contract

Thanks Priyom — cc'ed our AP team so they can confirm the vendor id details. A couple of follow-ups from AP:
- Net terms: our default is net60; net45 requires procurement head sign-off. Net30 is unlikely without an early payment discount.
- Discount: they asked if Redwood can do a 2% discount for net30; AP prefers that to any other mechanism.
- Pre-auth: the $25k preauth window works, but AP requires it to be documented in the PO comment and the invoice to reference the preauth id.

I'll escalate net45 internally but we may need price movement to accept net45 or net30. Please let us know the explicit pricing delta for different net terms so we can route for approval.

Katrina

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Katrina — thanks for the details and the templates. Quick answers upfront:
> - We can accept a single blanket PO that covers multiple SOW line items...

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lee <katrina.lee@horizontech.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO fields, invoice cadence and pre-auth for Redwood contract

Hi Katrina / Priyom,

Appreciate the clear ask. From a Redwood finance perspective we can do the following compromise to move HorizonTech through vendor onboarding quickly: 
- Accept HorizonTech's standard net60 if required, but we will apply a 1.5% surcharge to list pricing to offset DSO impact.
- Alternatively, accept net45 with no surcharge if Horizon commits to monthly consolidated invoices and a minimum quarterly spend of $75k (across the pilot + expansion lanes).
- For net30, we can offer a 2% early-pay discount, but this requires a signed commitment letter and a 30-day prepayment holdback policy (we'd reserve the right to apply a 5% holdback for new customers on net30 for the first invoice cycle).

Pre-auth: we can provision the $25k pre-auth; please add in PO comment: "PreAuth: HT-PA-001 — Redwood will issue one pre-auth invoice up to $25,000 referencing this id."

We will also accept the blanket PO approach. Priyom, I'll prepare an internal note with the price delta numbers and send the updated SOW pricing table for Katrina's AP team to map to their PO fields.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Katrina Lee <katrina.lee@horizontech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: HorizonTech AP <ap@horizontech.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO fields, invoice cadence and pre-auth for Redwood contract

Vanessa / Priyom — thank you, that compromise is workable. We will: 
- Accept net45 with monthly consolidated invoices and include the pre-auth comment HT-PA-001 in the PO header.
- AP will generate a single blanket PO referencing multiple invoice numbers.

Next steps for us: AP will issue the blanket PO by Friday once we receive the SOW line mapping and Redwood's vendor remit code (RW-00123). I will return the signed PO and send you the AP contact to expect invoices.

Please send the updated SOW with the mapped PO lines and a short note we can paste into the PO comment. Once AP confirms the PO number I will route for payment terms registration.

Thanks,
Katrina
Procurement Manager | HorizonTech
Attachments: none
